name: Charter Wideeye
description: Bit and beard cover the two sides of the body in a held guard, the haft crossing the chest.

name: Battlewrath
description: Bit and beard strike in turn, the second edge following the first by a breath.

name: Granite Smite
description: A pair of balanced steps carries the user into the opponent's guard.

name: Thornrive
description: The beard hooks and holds a blade while the bit presses the opponent's other side.

name: Impervious Warbit
description: Each edge in turn catches and turns a blow, and the head ends facing the opponent.

name: Toxin Battercut
description: The poll raps the opponent's weapon hand while the bit waits at the other side.

name: Bandedruin
description: Both edges strike one point twice in a breath and open a gap in the opponent's guard.

name: Mastering Warpoll
description: The two edges lock an enemy weapon between them and press it until the grip gives.

name: Rampaging Hewdown
description: Qi gathers along both edges and then falls in one cleave that no single guard stops.

name: Unconquered Warhelve
description: The user stands in a poised hawk's stance and waits with the head held high.

name: Crescentbit Wrath
description: The head falls from the high guard in a sudden dive.

name: Mightbanded
description: A long gliding step carries the user low past the opponent's guard.

name: Hoarfrost Bitedge
description: The beard catches the opponent's wrist like a talon and draws the arm forward.

name: Chime Battleheel
description: The axe beats aside a blow like a wing and returns in a lifting cut.

name: Energizing Haftcap
description: The user reads the whole of the opponent's stance from above his guard and marks his weak side.

name: Punishing Warcleave
description: A light, fast cut falls from above and strikes an opponent's uncovered forearm before he can turn.

name: Battlescourge
description: A diving cut sends qi through the edge, and it passes through the guard on one line.

name: Rive Glimmer
description: Qi carries the user in a single surge up from a low crouch to a high guard behind the opponent.

name: Ruinous Brunt
description: After a long hover the axe falls in a great dive, and nothing in its line withstands it.

name: Aegis Warpoll
description: The user sits low in a wide stance, letting blows spend themselves against the haft.

name: Rumblewarbit
description: A steady chop falls on the opponent's guard like a river wearing down a bank.

name: Silt Smite
description: A curving step sweeps around the opponent, following the bend of an imaginary river.

name: Brunt Tenacity
description: The beard hooks the opponent's front foot and drags it along the ground.

name: Shattering Warbeard
description: Two cuts join into one, the second falling into the line the first opened.

name: Warbitnerve
description: The haft turns a blow into a wide circle, spending the opponent's strength.

name: Mayhem Banded
description: The poll strikes low at the opponent's knee as his attention is on the high guard.

name: Tempered Warbit
description: Gathered qi floods through the edge and the cut passes a guard's inner line.

name: Intentrive
description: The haft presses down upon a weapon like silt settling, and the weapon cannot rise.

name: Galvanizing Wideeye
description: The user watches the flow of the opponent's weight like a river and finds the point where it will turn.

name: Daybreak Hewdown
description: Qi gathers and flows out in one sweeping cleave that fills the whole basin of the user's reach.

name: Iron Warbeard
description: Body and qi are held in two tracks along the haft, and the user's guard does not shake.

name: Sanguine Battleheel
description: A chop falls with the body track and the qi track joined at the bit.

name: Unseen Haftcap
description: The user glides from one track to the other and arrives at the opponent's flank.

name: Ponderous Battercut
description: The beard hooks and draws a limb while the qi track pushes the cut forward.

name: Glamour Warhelve
description: The haft catches a blow on the body track and returns it along the qi track.

name: Bandedhavoc
description: Both tracks meet in one narrow cut that passes the guard and strikes the body.

name: Bitedge Fortitude
description: The poll strikes a weapon hand on the body track while the qi track steadies the user.

name: Siltwarbit
description: Qi carries the user in a surge from guard to behind the opponent, where the cut already falls.

name: Titanic Hewdown
description: Both tracks of the body gather and release together, and the cleave falls with the whole of the user's strength.

name: Banded Mettle
description: The head is held at the top of its reach, and the user watches from beneath it.

name: Tempered Battleheel
description: The head falls the whole of its length in a straight, heavy cut.

name: Silt Crescentbit
description: The user drops one pace forward as the head falls, so the step and cut land together.

name: Rive Spine
description: The beard hooks the opponent's raised arm and draws it down into the line of the cut.

name: Ironbanded
description: The user lands from a spring into a chop that carries all the weight of the fall.

name: Battlenerve
description: The head falls across a blow and turns it into the ground.

name: Chime Warhelve
description: A downward rap of the poll on the opponent's raised hand breaks his hold.

name: Illuminating Wideeye
description: Qi gathers in the head at its highest point and builds with the wait.

name: Hollowrive
description: A falling cut sends qi through the edge, and it passes through guard, armour and shield on one line.

name: Invincible Banded
description: A great burst of qi at the moment of landing throws back any attack aimed at the user.

name: Warbit Glare
description: The user surges from height to the opponent's back, the cut already descending.

name: Smite Scourge
description: The axe falls from its highest guard in a single cleave whose weight no guard withstands.

name: Facet Haftcap
description: The two edges of the head cover the two sides of the body and the haft covers the centre.

name: Blaze Rive
description: The head turns in the hands in mid-swing and the second edge strikes in place of the first.

name: Unseen Warpoll
description: A half-step shifts the user to the line of the second edge.

name: Immobilizing Warcleave
description: The flat of the head shoves a shield aside and the other edge waits behind it.

name: Granite Warcleave
description: Two edges cut at once from opposing sides of a turning head.

name: Warbitdurance
description: One edge catches the blade and the other edge strikes the hand that held it.

name: Titanic Brunt
description: Both edges cut the same line in turn and the second passes through the opening the first made.

name: Intentbanded
description: The two edges close on the opponent's weapon and hold it still against the haft.

name: Headlong Warcleave
description: The user surges to the side the second edge covers, striking before the opponent has turned.

name: Granite Battercut
description: The head makes a full turn through both edges in a single great cut that cannot be read.

name: Hoarfrost Crescentbit
description: The user stands wide on both feet and covers the front with the haft.

name: Blazebattle
description: A broad level swing cuts a wide arc at the opponent's chest.

name: Warbeard Glare
description: A wide circling step moves the user around the edge of the opponent's reach.

name: Battleheel Fortitude
description: The beard hooks both ankles in a low sweep and brings the opponent down.

name: Ironrive
description: Two sweeps follow in one flowing motion, the second striking the guard that moved.

name: Unbowed Warhelve
description: A wheeling haft turns blows aside across the whole front of the user.

name: Rumble Battercut
description: The flat of the head sweeps across several shields at once and moves them aside.

name: Downpour Hewdown
description: A held sweep stirs the ground and keeps the opponents in reach struggling to hold their footing.

name: Unbowed Wideeye
description: A great wheel of the axe catches every blow aimed at the user and throws them back.

name: Granite Rive
description: Qi carries the user across the width of the basin's reach in one surge, ending in a cut.

name: Wrathful Slag Warbit
description: Qi gathers and goes out in a single, wide sweep that cuts every opponent in front of the user.

name: Aegis Warbeard
description: The user holds a guard like a bank against the current, and blows break against the haft.

name: Smite Ruin
description: A chop follows a steady current and the opponent is carried along with it.

name: Torrent Warpoll
description: The user flows into the gap in the opponent's guard like water through a break in a bank.

name: Hoarfrost Brunt
description: The beard hooks and turns the opponent in a small circle.

name: Buoying Banded
description: Qi settles in the head like silt in a still pool and grows heavy with the wait.

name: Battlevalor
description: The haft turns a blow along its length and sends it past the user.

name: Nova Bitedge
description: A narrow cut sends qi like a rushing sluice through the opponent's guard.

name: Strangling Smite
description: The head floods the opponent's weapon with a heavy press and holds it down.

name: Iron Haftcap
description: The axe falls like a river in flood, with all the weight of the gathered current behind it.

name: Battlespine
description: The user stands as if sworn to the ground and the haft covers the front.

name: Tempered Battercut
description: A straight chop falls on the bearing the user has taken and does not drift.

name: Mightrive
description: A running step along the plateau carries the user to the opponent's flank.

name: Overbearing Crescentbit
description: The beard hooks and pulls into the wind, and the opponent comes with it.

name: Shattering Warhelve
description: Two cuts fall on the same bearing, and the second is stronger than the first.

name: Unassailable Crescentbit
description: A parry on a fixed bearing turns the blow along the line of the wind.

name: Toxin Haftcap
description: A sweep of the haft across the whole front clears the opponent's approach with no wall behind the user.

name: Glintbanded
description: A narrow cut on the sworn bearing carries qi through the opponent's guard.

name: Silt Banded
description: Qi carries the user along the bearing in one surge, ending in a cut on the line.

name: Ferocious Tempered Wideeye
description: The user speaks the oath, qi rises with the wind, and one great cleave falls on the bearing.

name: Charter Bitedge
description: The user holds the head high and covers the front like a wall of wind, though no wall stands.

name: Corroding Hewdown
description: A sudden cut falls like a gust and is over before the opponent turns.

name: Gust Brunt
description: A step into the wind steadies the user and presses the opponent back.

name: Gyve Bitedge
description: The beard hooks and drags the opponent in the gale's direction.

name: Gnashing Warcleave
description: Two quick gusts of qi follow two quick cuts, and the second finds the open guard.

name: Toxin Warpoll
description: The poll raps sideways at a weapon hand like a crosswind on a banner.

name: Chimebattle
description: The edge turns a blade away as wind turns smoke.

name: Eviscerating Warbit
description: A gust of qi at the bit carries the edge through a guard.

name: Siltrive
description: Qi bears the user across the gap in a gust and lands the cut as he arrives.

name: Glintbattle
description: A burst of qi from the haft throws back every blow aimed at the user, like a squall.

name: Unsparing Rive
description: Qi gathers along the whole edge and goes out in a wide, gale-like cut across the front.

name: Facetbattle
description: The user holds a single bearing in stance and does not turn from it.

name: Warbeard Wrath
description: A chop falls along the bearing at the speed of a spoken word.

name: Headlong Crescentbit
description: A step along the bearing carries the user into the opponent's guard.

name: Thornbrunt
description: The beard hooks and draws an opponent onto the user's bearing.

name: Adamantine Warhelve
description: The haft turns a blow along the user's bearing and returns it along the wind.

name: Harnessing Rive
description: The poll rap lands on a weapon hand along the sworn line.

name: Corroding Battercut
description: A narrow cut on the sworn bearing carries qi through the guard.

name: Warcleave Slipstream
description: Qi carries the user along the bearing in a surge and the cut lands on arrival.

name: Ferocious Haftcap Havoc
description: The user speaks the oath, holds the bearing, and brings the whole axe down in one great cleave.

name: Aegis Battleheel
description: The user stands with open ground behind and holds the head across the body.

name: Devastating Banded
description: A straight, honest chop falls in the open with no cover to hide it.

name: Gust Warbeard
description: A free step moves the user anywhere on open ground with no obstacle at his back.

name: Ponderous Warpoll
description: The beard hooks and draws the opponent out into the open.

name: Equipoise Bitedge
description: The haft turns a blow aside as the wind carries it past.

name: Bruntruin
description: Two chops fall on one bearing and the second goes where the first opened.

name: Intent Wideeye
description: Qi gathers in the head like a rising wind and builds with the user's patience.

name: Battledurance
description: The poll raps at a weapon hand on open ground and the opponent has nowhere to retreat.

name: Battleheel Ruin
description: A narrow cut carries qi through the guard in a straight line to the body.

name: Granite Warbit
description: Qi carries the user across the open ground in a single surge.

name: Glamour Wideeye
description: A great gust of qi from the haft throws every blow back upon the attacker.

name: Bitedge Scourge
description: Qi rises like a gale and the axe cleaves a wide arc across the open ground, with no wall to stop it.

name: Aegiswarbit
description: The user faces the wind with the head held high and the haft steady.

name: Ironbattle
description: A chop thrown into the wind lands slowly but cuts deep.

name: Silt Hewdown
description: A step along the line of the wind carries the user to the opponent's flank.

name: Ponderous Brunt
description: The beard hooks and draws the opponent into the wind.

name: Blaze Hewdown
description: Two chops fall one after the other into the wind, and the second finds the opening.

name: Torrent Crescentbit
description: The haft turns the blow and the wind carries it away from the user.

name: Rumble Banded
description: The poll raps a weapon hand with the force of a gust.

name: Bruntscourge
description: A narrow cut carries qi into the wind and through the guard.

name: Mightsmite
description: Qi lifts the user in a surge across the gap into the wind's side.

name: Smite Devastation
description: The axe falls from the full height of its reach into the wind and cleaves whatever is in its line.

name: Thorn Haftcap
description: The user stands on a sworn word and holds the axe across the body.

name: Iron Brunt
description: A chop thrown with the wind at the user's back falls faster than it was swung.

name: Battleglare
description: A step on a sworn word carries the user in a straight line.

name: Overbearing Battercut
description: The beard hooks an opponent's weapon and draws it down the wind.

name: Unbudging Battleheel
description: A parry on a sworn word turns the blow without a step back.

name: Maiming Warpoll
description: The poll raps the weapon hand and spoils the grip.

name: Decimating Warcleave
description: A narrow cut sends qi along the wind and through the opponent's guard.

name: Silt Warhelve
description: Qi carries the user in a surge on a sworn line and the cut lands at the end.

name: Warbit Ruin
description: The user speaks the oath, and the axe falls with all of the wind behind it.

name: Impenetrable Warbeard
description: The user holds the axe across the body and keeps the bearing under any push.

name: Warbeard Reckoning
description: A chop falls on the kept bearing without wavering.

name: Mightbrunt
description: A measured step holds the bearing while closing on the opponent.

name: Rivevalor
description: The beard hooks and draws the opponent onto the user's bearing.

name: Intentbattle
description: Qi gathers in the head over a long hold of the bearing and grows heavy.

name: Warbitmettle
description: A parry on the held bearing turns a blow aside without a loss of line.

name: Smite Hardihood
description: The poll raps along the kept line and spoils an opponent's attack.

name: Pitiless Warcleave
description: A narrow cut on the kept bearing carries qi through the guard.

name: Meteoric Bitedge
description: Qi bears the user along the bearing in a surge and the cut lands on arrival.

name: Glamour Warpoll
description: A burst of qi from the haft throws any blow back along the bearing.

name: Glint Battleheel
description: The user holds the bearing and brings the whole axe down in a single cleave, with the whole fight behind it.

name: Charter Warbit
description: The user stands on open ground and holds the head high across the body.

name: Smitewrath
description: A chop falls without obstacle in the open and carries all its weight.

name: Riveglare
description: A running step carries the user along the plateau's edge and into the opponent's flank.

name: Warbitspine
description: The beard hooks a limb and pulls it along the wind.

name: Sanguine Warhelve
description: Two chops fall in the open on one bearing, the second finding the opening.

name: Gustwarbit
description: A parry on open ground turns the blow and leaves the user's line unchanged.

name: Rive Obduracy
description: The poll raps wide and strikes the weapon hand from an unexpected angle.

name: Glint Battercut
description: A narrow cut sends qi through the guard and into the body.

name: Unseen Hewdown
description: Qi carries the user across the open ground in a single surge.

name: Punishing Blaze Smite
description: Qi rises like a wind and the axe cleaves across the whole front in one great sweep.
